items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 7.5.6 at source lines 1133-1136: if f : A -> B is n-connected then g : B -> C is n-connected if and only if g o f is. The author's proof (source lines 1138-1151) is a three-step chain of equivalences of truncations at a fixed c : C in which each step is a different input: the octahedron identity identifies the fiber of the composite with a total space of fibers (source lines 1141-1143), truncation inside a dependent sum moves the inner truncation inward (lines 1144-1145), and the hypothesis that f is n-connected contracts the inner truncated fibers (lines 1146-1147). Only after the chain does the equivalence of contractibility statements follow (lines 1149-1150). The statement records none of the three steps.
